name: Workplace: creative studio
about: A design, architecture, media or advertising studio: one open studio with room to pin up and review, a materials library, a workshop for models, edit and sound rooms that want no window, a gallery at the front. The Workplace typology underneath it; only what this kind of office adds or sizes differently is said here.

uses.name: Studio
uses.about: The open studio: long tables, screens, work on the walls.

uses.name: Review space
uses.about: Where work is pinned up and talked through.

uses.name: Materials library
uses.about: Samples on shelves and in drawers, a table to lay them out by daylight.

uses.name: Workshop
uses.about: Model making: benches, a sink, dust and noise kept in.

uses.name: Photo studio
uses.about: A clear floor and height for lights; daylight shut out when needed.

uses.name: Edit suite
uses.about: Picture and colour: no window, or one that blacks out.

uses.name: Sound booth
uses.about: Recording and voice: a room within a room, no window.

uses.name: Render room
uses.about: Machines that run hot and loud, shut away.

uses.name: Gallery
uses.about: Work on show at the front.
